report.referenceMethod: Original last + positive harmonic disk correspondence for main panels and retessellated mapped boundaries; independent geometric fitting, not Rhino SquishBack or calibrated leather mechanics; R07 derived rounded cuts, metric needle slits, skin-seated static saddle routes and native cup-rim seating.

registration.method: Overlapping source surfaces: upward last-underside ray vs downward native outsole-top ray; robust vertical registration. Not contact dynamics.

seamRecovery.method: Split unsupported source gaps; resample supported intervals by formed millimetre arc length

22.method: LSCM + explicit positive-chart line search; median metric normalized to millimetres

contactRepair.method: Existing P28 source boundary re-registered under the quarter and facing; no additional cover mesh

stitches.method: Inset from finished boundary in formed millimetres, common two-layer needle frame, 0.72 x 0.44 mm slit target

sole.method: Native cup-outsole upper-lip radial re-registration to actual assembled upper; 4mm vertical fade, 8.5mm / 28%-radius displacement bound, monotone radial map; no added welt

limits: Static geometry only. Finite hole-centre rays and stitch-midpoint rays are not whole-thread/full-shell collision proof. No shoe manufacturing, force-solved sewing or adhesive bond certification.
